name: VANDIRA Proactive Alerts & Monitoring
purpose: Detect meaningful changes in Uttar Pradesh political intelligence without inventing events or generating targeted persuasion.
rules: A new article is not automatically a verified fact
Duplicate URLs and near-identical titles are suppressed
Conflicting evidence is surfaced rather than resolved by guessing
Historical data does not become a live alert unless a fresh source changes it
No sensitive personal attributes are used for political targeting
Forecasts and probabilities are not invented
delivery: STEP100 provides deterministic detection and UI-ready alerts. Push/email/SMS delivery requires a separately configured scheduler/channel and is not claimed by the static Pages runtime.
